name: coopani-world-life
description: 模拟鱼生 · 50职业含医疗就医、30天证书核验、31项城邦Buff、高德天气直连、信用社借贷与七页签手账 UI。（需 Coopani 0.2.22+｜QQ 群 284525159）

zh.description:
让桌宠有自己真正在过的小日子（需 Coopani 0.2.22+｜QQ 群 284525159）。

- **50 职业、14 证书与医疗就医闭环**：覆盖 4 档共 50 个职业（含药店店员、社区医生等 4 个医疗康复岗）与 14 本证书（新增茶艺咖啡证、园艺花艺证、导游证、执业医师证），引入熟练度加薪与四档产出品质，新增生病静养每日照料与 `see_doctor` 社区诊所就医，并启用 30 天证书见识复核与 5 天预警宽限。
- **Coopanion Hub v1.3 多城联机与 31 项城镇加成**：支持 `hubUrl` / `hubTownId` 热配置（面板一键复制与填入总服地址）、跨城迁居、31 项城邦加成联动、跨城鱼市街摆摊买摊、邻里代管、鱼间私信及信用社微息借贷；留空 `hubUrl` 100% 兼容老服或单机。
- **七页签手账 UI 与高德天气直连**：包含此刻、职业与五大工坊、她惦记的、你与街坊、农牧与集市、日记时间轴与参考素材库，天气支持高德直连复用 `JOURNEY_AMAP_KEY`。
- **真实节奏与农牧工坊**：五条需求随真实时间流逝与二十四节气变化；18 道菜谱工坊、18 种慢熟作物与鸡舍/牛棚/鱼塘养殖（大肥鱼是鲸鱼不算鱼，放心养鱼收肉蛋奶）。

en.description:
A real everyday life simulation for your desktop companion (Needs Coopani 0.2.22+ · QQ group 284525159).

- **Reedpond Credit Union & Pocket Money Gifts**: Adds 3 micro-interest loan tiers (7d/14d/30d) with dynamic credit limits up to 5000 RMB, an 80 RMB living-cash floor on maturity, 50% overdue income garnishment, and strictly read-only UI keeping borrowing autonomous; plus a collapsible Pocket Money gift bar (500 RMB daily soft cap, configurable) tracked separately from earned income.
- **Coopanion Hub v1.1 Multi-City Online (Dual-Track)**: Optional `hubUrl` and `hubTownId` hot settings (plus one-click copy & auto-fill) enable cross-town relocation, town notices and 31 domain buffs, cross-town stalls with specialty tags and transparent shipping breakdown, same-town neighbor errands, and 24 tools total. Leaving `hubUrl` empty keeps 100% compatibility with legacy `townUrl` or offline mode.
- **Revamped 7-Tab Journal UI**: Refreshed layout and controls across Live Status, Career & 5 Craft Studios (Cooking, Photo, Craft, Writing, Driving), Wants, Companionship & Mail, Farm & Market, Diary & Timeline, and Reference Library—with town switching, batch/direct farm & ranch controls, daily sick care & clinic visits (`see_doctor`), specialty/local filters, order cancellation, and read-only fish-to-fish mailbox view.
- **Daily Rhythm, Career & Farm Workshop**: Real-time five needs with 24 solar terms & direct Amap weather (`amap` / `auto` reusing `JOURNEY_AMAP_KEY`), 50 jobs across 4 tiers (including 4 medical jobs) with proficiency pay scaling & 4-tier output quality, 14 certs with 30-day knowledge audit, overwork/cold sick rest & daily care, 18 recipes, 18 crops, and poultry/dairy/pond farming (Big Fish is a whale, not a fish!).
